findings.rationale: Accepted: CLAUDE.md returns to §2.5 as an exact output_paths + allowed_path_prefixes entry (implementation-campaign-check accepts normalized === prefix; the scope session's <prefix>/** governs new paths only), check-claude-md-inventory.js is in §4.1, the byte-identity clause is removed — R6 holds at the candidate as frozen.

Accepted: §1.3 now closes every inherited descriptor above 2 before bwrap and opens fd 9 only afterwards; §2.6 names inherited fds as a denied channel; §1.5(a) drives the launcher from a parent holding exec 7< on a host secret and asserts /proc/self/fd and that /proc/self/fd/7 and /9 cannot be reopened.
Accepted (same defect as finding 0): all three places aligned — §2 docs, §2.5 sealed paths, §4 scope-integrity and §4.1 now carry CLAUDE.md + check-claude-md-inventory.js at the candidate.

Accepted: preflight runs test -e on each --deny-path on the host before entering the namespace and exits 2 naming a missing path; §1.5(e) gains the nonexistent-path case (never 0); §4 preflight row updated.
Accepted: --timeout is the coreutils DURATION grammar forwarded untouched; §1.6 uses the suite's real default 5m, §1.5(b) uses 2s.
Accepted: --seat-root is mkdir -m 0700 of the exact path, exit 2 'seat root already exists' if present, and only a launcher-created root is removed; §1.5(h) plus a portable stub case.
Accepted: the host credential path is a literal resolved on the host before launch; /home/review/.codex/auth.json readable is the positive control (§1.5(a), §4 boundary).
Accepted: refusal message and header state that the codex release directory (codex beside codex-code-mode-host) is required and the npm wrapper layout is unsupported in this cut (§1.2).
Accepted as recorded follow-up: §3 now states the §5 check proves one survival, not that rotation cannot occur; near-expiry refusal and the re-login recovery path are 1b-B decisions.
